info.title: OpenAI API (filtered)
info.description: Filtered OpenAPI spec containing only schemas referenced by this connector.

User.description: Represents an individual `user` within an organization.

object.description: The object type, which is always `organization.user`

id.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

email.description: The email address of the user

added_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the user was added.

UsageCompletionsResult.description: The aggregated completions usage details of the specific time bucket.

input_tokens.description: The aggregated number of text input tokens used, including cached tokens.

input_cached_tokens.description: The aggregated number of text input tokens that has been cached from previous requests.

output_tokens.description: The aggregated number of text output tokens used.

input_audio_tokens.description: The aggregated number of audio input tokens used, including cached tokens.

output_audio_tokens.description: The aggregated number of audio output tokens used.

num_model_requests.description: The count of requests made to the model.

project_id.description: When `group_by=project_id`, this field provides the project ID of the grouped usage result.

user_id.description: When `group_by=user_id`, this field provides the user ID of the grouped usage result.

api_key_id.description: When `group_by=api_key_id`, this field provides the API key ID of the grouped usage result.

model.description: When `group_by=model`, this field provides the model name of the grouped usage result.

batch.description: When `group_by=batch`, this field tells whether the grouped usage result is batch or not.

service_tier.description: When `group_by=service_tier`, this field provides the service tier of the grouped usage result.
